zh.displayName: 更好的GPTSovits 语音—大肥鱼来咯
zh.description: 支持星落落语音包！欢迎来尝试！给桌宠配上真实的 GPT-SoVITS 语音：全程在本机合成、从声卡出声，不上传任何录音，一键装好运行时与模型。和 RVC 变声、DiffSinger 唱歌是同一套本机声音链路，三个插件可以配合使用：说话走本插件、唱歌走 DiffSinger、音色交给 RVC。内置「大肥鱼_星落落版本」参考音色（官方底模零样本）与日中英三种参考；支持自定义音色（参考音频+台本+可选自备权重）。自带闲置停服（省显存）、按需加载（最多省约 810 MB 显存）、语音落盘与保留期。还能把声音交给 QQ 插件：新版 cortico-world-qq-final 直接取本机语音接口，老版 cortico-world-qq 走句柄，QQ 语音就是桌宠的声音。新版 QQ 插件（0.6.29 起）已移除语音判定模型，不需要任何密钥，是否发语音由主模型自己决定。AMD 显卡用户可使用 CPU 推理档（速度较慢但可用）。

en.description: Supports the Xll voice pack! Come and try it! Gives the desktop pet a real GPT-SoVITS voice: synthesized on your own machine, nothing uploaded, one-click runtime and weights. It is one link of the same local voice chain as RVC (timbre) and DiffSinger singing, and the three plugins can run together: speech here, singing in DiffSinger, timbre in RVC. Ships the "Fatfish Xll" reference voice (zero-shot base model) plus Chinese/English/Japanese references, and supports custom voices (reference audio + transcript + optional own weights). Includes stop-when-idle, on-demand model loading (up to ~810 MB VRAM saved), speech files with a retention window, and a local voice API so QQ plugins (cortico-world-qq-final / cortico-world-qq) can send voice in the pet's own voice. Newer QQ plugins (0.6.29+) need no key at all: the main model decides when to speak. AMD GPU users can use the CPU inference tier (slower but works).

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build && npm test && npm run typecheck
